From classic teddy bears to friendly lions, floppy-eared bunnies to adorable puppies, every child cherishes those hours of snuggles and cuddles with their favourite soft toys. While our very own Harrods bears make delightful gifts, Jellycat can be relied upon for super-soft companions and Steiff purveys the ultimate in luxury with collectibles that can be passed down from generation to generation.

Labubu dolls – fuzzy, elvish creatures with impish ears and mischievous grins – first appeared in artist Kasing Lung’s Monsters picture books in 2015, inspired by Nordic folklore. But what started on the page became a pop-culture phenomenon in 2024, when the likes of Rihanna, Dua Lipa and BlackPink’s Lisa were spotted styling the characters as playful luxury bag charms.

You’ll find plush friends from Moulin Roty and designer dolls from Danish OYOY, which stimulate daytime creativity and offer nighttime comfort, while The Den Kit Company and Toylander are destination brands for your mini-me who can’t wait to be all grown up. For hours of endless fun, turn to our array of exciting action figures and accessories. Whether children want to be transported to the realms of Harry Potter, Star Wars, DC Comics and beyond, our selection – suitable for all ages – makes for endless gifting options or the start of a much-loved haul of collectibles.

The Wellness Clinic presents a holistic collection of treatments and services with an integrated approach to wellbeing and beauty. World-renowned experts, whose fields include aesthetics, wellness and dermatology, and provide personalised fitness, nutrition, and remedial services, are all available in one space.
The in-store pharmacy can fulfill prescriptions and stocks a range of medical and complementary therapy supplies.
Interior-design and home-styling solutions, from a single room to a full revamp. The team works with home brands in-store, and has relationships with international brands and bespoke suppliers.

Exceptional perfume houses, rare fragrances, and bespoke services; look to Salon de Pafums at Harrods.

The Beauty Halls are world-class, immersive spaces on the Ground Floor where you’ll find prestigious brands and cult products. Head down the spectacular golden staircase to Beauty Events & Services, home to exclusive events, must-book treatments and the Beauty Concierge.

Exclusive to Harrods, Drybar offers an elevated blow-dry experience for every occasion – we’re talking a spontaneous date night, hen do, work party and beyond. Because sometimes all your hair needs is a really good blow-dry.

Featuring state-of-the-art technology and with dedicated optometrists with more than 30 years’ experience, the Harrods Opticians offer a one-hour glazing service and a range of styles from leading brands.

Shield your eyes in style this season with our selection of women’s designer sunglasses. Suited for home or holiday, women’s sunglasses add a hit of interest to any outfit – whether you favour sculpted frames, classic aviators or futuristic wrap-around silhouettes. Cat eye sunglasses are calling to be worn on the shores of Capri, while square sunglasses are all that’s needed to complete the look of a maximalist metropolitan. Want the delicious taste of the Food Halls food in your own home? Be it fresh, seasonal produce, gourmet pantry staples or delicious comfort classics prepared by Harrods chefs, our delivery vans are poised and ready to deliver the best of the Food Halls, straight to your door.

There are some hunger pangs that only fresh, homemade pasta can temper – and don’t the Pasta Evangelists know it. With a view to bringing authentic regional Italian dishes to London, they opened their first fresh pasta counter in Harrods in 2018, followed by their first restaurant venture in our very own Dining Hall not long after. The convivial buzz. The tantalising menu. The opulent surroundings. It’s not hard to imagine how Em Sherif captured the hearts (and stomachs) of Beirut in 2011 with its first restaurant. Founded by the brilliant chef patron Mireille Hayek, the franchise is credited for putting Lebanese fine dining on the map. Just last year, The World’s 50 Best Restaurants listed it as one of the top nine female-led restaurants to watch – and watch we shall, as Hayek opens her 11th outpost (her first in Europe)

A taste of America, without the trans-Atlantic trip; the first Gordon Ramsay Burger restaurant outside of Las Vegas has touched down in Knightsbridge, and as you’d expect from Michelin-starred chef Gordon Ramsay, these are not your average quarter-pounders. A bespoke blend of chuck, brisket and rib cap, the 100% UK heritage beef patties are cooked to perfection on an open flame and – just before they’re taken off the grill – brushed with Ivy House Farm butter for an extra hit of nutty sweetness.

Adding a luxury spin to the best of pan-Asian cuisine, Chai Wu boasts a menu that is bursting with flavours, textures and colours. You’ll find picture-perfect dim sum (topped with beluga caviar, gold leaf or black truffle), tempura soft-shell crab and lobster wonton soup, alongside sizzling Szechuan chicken and Japanese Miyazaki beef. Got an old watch that’s just gathering dust? Our new Fine Watches Part Exchange service allows you to trade in a fine watch you longer have use for. Simply bring it in-store to any boutique within the Fine Watch Rooms to get an initial quote by a Harrods sales representative. Then, the watch will be tested and evaluated to confirm the final value, which can be loaded onto a Harrods Gift Card for you to spend anywhere in-store.

metadata.description: Whether you’re looking to invest in the latest trends, curate your very own capsule wardrobe or treat yourself to a sartorial icon, our vast selection of women's clothing is second to none. Encompassing brands both big and small, emerging and established, there’s styles to suit every taste and each occasion, from knockout party pieces to off-duty casuals and functional underpinnings.

Say hello to your new workout wardrobe, comprising everything from high-performance running gear and super-stylish yoga pants to the perfect all-terrain trainers and weatherproof jackets. Courtesy of the most covetable sports labels, including Nike and Adidas by Stella McCartney, our edit of women’s sportswear essentials offers an instant sports kit refresh - perfect for the gym and outdoor endeavours alike.
